author: Bril, Isabelle
title: Processus évolutifs de langues de l'extrême nord de la Nouvelle-Calédonie : le cas du nêlêmwa-nixumwak et du zuanga-yuanga
notes: Consulted directly on 23 November 2026 (Cairn PDF; tables read from page images). Data from the author's fieldwork 1990-2012; Nemi and Jawe from Haudricourt & Ozanne-Rivierre (1982). Varieties: Zuanga of Kaala-Gomen (gos, dental vs post-alveolar consonants, no final consonants), Zuanga of Paimboa, Kuru-Wemu and Wehole (pa, wem, weh; 'gon', transitional), Yuanga of Bondé (bo), Nêlêmwa (nel) and Nixumwak (nix) (pp. 197-198). Vowels and diphthongs (Tableaux 1-3), aspirates from geminates (5a-b, 9), dentals vs post-alveolars in gos (6), order of changes after Ozanne-Rivierre (1995) (7, 7*), initial, intervocalic and final consonants (8, 10, 11), summary with PNC and Proto-North NC (12), and reflexes etymon by etymon (Tableaux 13-37). Written in French; translations here are ours.
